text:
maya: Noticing periodic p95 tail spikes in eu-west dedicated pool A around 03:20 UTC, seems correlated with dozens of tiny 50-200ms model init allocs from the same tenant. link: https://dash.internal/poolA/spikes
asif: Yep same. net metrics show NIC TX bursts and switch drops on rack-9. GPU util flat. Looks like allocation churn not compute.
lina: Tenant-side: looks like new client SDK version does aggressive reconnects and does small parallel requests. We should reach out to them but need infra mitigations first.
maya: Two possible infra levers: 1) temporary prewarm routing for offending tenant to reduce alloc rate 2) host-level nic egress shaping and per-tenant admission control on the gateway.
ops-bot: incident: automatic noisy-tenant detection flagged tenant "beta-co" with burstiness score 82 at 03:22 UTC.
ryan: For quick wins, I suggest adding a transient qoslvl tag and route to the warm-pool: `rls route set beta-co --pool=warm-small --ttl=30m` That keeps latency stable and avoids a dedicated pool commit.
tasha: Cost caveat: warm-pool is shared and has burst credits; long-lived reroute for heavy customers will leak cost. If this persists we should propose a temporary dedicated carve with cost allocation.
asif: I can trial an eBPF policer on rack-9 to cap bursts (pktshaper). If switch is dropping, shaping reduces tail drops. I'll run non-disruptive test with 5% sample.
lina: Also propose a proxy-level small-batch coalescer tweak: increase continuous-batcher window from 5ms to 12ms for this pool. That should let many tiny allocs coalesce into one batch without harming median latency.
maya: Action plan: 1) asif to run eBPF policer test (5% hosts) 2) ryan to apply temporary route to warm-pool for beta-co for 30m canary 3) lina to bump coalescer window in staging and push canary 4) tasha to open cost ticket for infra-costs review.
ryan: Starting route change now, will post runbook: `rls route set beta-co --pool=warm-small --who=ryan --reason=impulse-mitigation` will monitor p95.
asif: eBPF test started on rack-9: `tcp_egress_shaper --limit=120mbps --burst=5mb` sampling 5 hosts. KPI hooks: if application-level drop increases, roll back.
ops-bot: deploy notice: canary "coalesce-window-bump" rolling to eu-west pool A at 03:45 UTC by infra-team (size 4 hosts).
maya: Ping client success-team to ask SDK owners to stagger reconnects. I'll DM.
lina: Adding metric: `tenant_impulse_rate` and `alloc_churn_rate` to pool dashboards and a low-priority alert if either > threshold for 10m.
tasha: Filing cost ticket now: INFRA-2391. Tagging finance and account execs. :money_with_wings: 
ryan: Canary green so far, p95 down from 420ms -> 110ms after route change. Leaving warm-pool route for 30m then evaluate.
maya: Nice. After 30m we'll decide whether to keep route, escalate to temporary dedicated slice, or push SDK fix request. Closing this thread when we have remediation decision.
